subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: The pipeline map shall state the stage-8 binding as it operationally runs — never a stale or aspirational one; the map is the live surface that owns the current value.
rationale: the map is descriptive and corrected-to-match; the stale row caused the E-36 deferral; when the engine era changes the operational binding (prd:argus WR-1 — NG-5's park), this row's fit re-pins to the new truth by amendment rather than the map asserting the old one
fit_criterion: inspection at this contract's checkpoint: the stage-8 row and footer state the external binding as it runs today — frozen plans project onto the tracker with the repo-configured automated-implementation tag, an external fleet claims and implements them, the pyxis-native engine not built — and no drive guidance still directs deferring materialization on the row's account
